# Place Name

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:PlaceName`](gmeow-PlaceName.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/PlaceName>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/names`](../../slices/names.md)

An appellation (toponym) borne by a geographic place via [`gmeow:hasPlaceName`](../properties/gmeow-hasPlaceName.md) — possibly endonym/exonym ([`gmeow:namePurpose`](../properties/gmeow-namePurpose.md)), multilingual, or historical (held over a period via a [`gmeow:NameUsage`](gmeow-NameUsage.md) / inferred [`gmeow:PlaceNaming`](gmeow-PlaceNaming.md)). The structured, first-class replacement for the retired flat gmeow:alternateName literal, used for gazetteer matching and co-equal multilingual/historical naming.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Appellation`](gmeow-Appellation.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:PlaceName`](gmeow-PlaceName.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Appellation`](gmeow-Appellation.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
